description: Stage 2 primary (drift): single-domain batches fixed once; orders differ in block sequence and batch order within blocks. Scored online and on the current regime's holdout, not on the mixture holdout.
derived_from: configs/pilot_toy_stationary.json (world, model, order_aware subspace, lr grid, MIE unchanged)

preregistration.question: Under the same meta supervision and adaptation budget, does the order penalty add utility?
preregistration.primary_metric: mean over regime blocks of the current-regime holdout error at each block end; online error separately

seeds.selection: first 3 of the pre-registered replicate seeds [0..4] and first 8 of the pre-registered order seeds [1000..1015]; not chosen by performance
seeds.independence: 3 seeds are the only independent units; orders are nested in seeds

tuning_range.selection: min mean_regime_end_error on development/dev_holdout over tuning orders; ties -> smaller lr
tuning_range.equal_budget: same grid, same tuning orders, same steps for every tuned arm

splits.meta_train: source-distribution samples under simulated shifts M*; subspace fitting only; labels used by order_aware (supervised gain term), not by gradpca/random
splits.development: validation shifts V*; lr tuning stream
splits.dev_holdout: validation shifts V*; tuning terminal evaluation (and calibration evaluation protocol)
splits.calibration: validation shifts V*; stream for global update-norm calibration
splits.test_stream: test shifts T*; the replayed multiset (labels read only by the prequential scorer)
splits.test_holdout: test shifts T*; common terminal holdout (labels read only by the terminal evaluator)

information_parity.tent_orderaware: meta_train inputs+labels (utility term), meta pool/HVP/JVP, order penalty lam=1
information_parity.tent_utility_only: identical meta batches, labels, pool, HVP/JVP; lam=0; rank = candidate rank
information_parity.norm_matched_per_step_causal: candidate's step-t update norm from a lockstep replica (steps <= t only)
information_parity.norm_matched_global: candidate's mean terminal displacement on the calibration split; no labels read

preregistration.previously_viewed: no pilot-world test data has been evaluated before this stage; the smoke run and unit tests used differently specified worlds
